{{Documentation subpage}}

== Usage ==
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox Japanese clan
| surname         = Name (+ "clan") [default: page name]
| surname nihongo = Kanji
| image           = File:X
| image size      = image size in pixels
| image caption   = caption for image
| home province   = Name & Wikilink <br />Name & Wikilink etc.
| parent house    = Name & Wikilink
| titles          = Name & Wikilink <br />Name & Wikilink etc.
| founder         = Name & Wikilink
| final ruler     = Name & Wikilink
| current head    = Name & Wikilink
| founding year   = YYYY
| dissolution     = YYYY
| ruled until     = YYYY (+ reason)
| cadet branches  = Name & Wikilink <br />Name & Wikilink etc.
</syntaxhighlight>

== Example ==
{{Infobox Japanese clan
| surname         = Example Name
| surname nihongo = Example kanji
| image           = File:Japanese crest Sagari Fuji.svg
| image size      = 
| image caption   = Example caption
| home province   = Example province
| parent house    = Example Clan
| titles          = Shogun
| founder         = Example no Example
| final ruler     = Example Example
| current head    = Example
| founding year   = 10XX
| dissolution     = 11XX
| ruled until     = 1112 (killed by pirates)
| cadet branches  = None
}}
